name: 3D Floor Grid (Camera Link)
description: An infinite 3D floor grid that follows the real scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch): when the camera moves, turns or zooms the floor stays in place in 3D. Grid, dots, circular or stripe floors with sub lines, line width in screen pixels, glow, floor fill, distance fade, horizon glow and forward travel for synthwave looks. Falls back to a manual camera when the patch is off.
